dashboard.label: Rainfall Totals
dashboard.description: ZENTRA Cloud charts Precipitation as rainfall during each 15-minute interval (see https://zentracloud.com/#/dashboard_detail/z6-30302). This view leaves those interval samples unchanged and sums them into daily and weekly accumulation so customers can see how much rain fell over a day or week. Units match the logger account (typically mm).

search.query: `zentra_weather_search` | stats count by device_sn | sort device_sn

single.title: Rain this period (sum of 15-minute samples)

search.query: | stats sum(value) as rainfall latest(units) as units | eval value = if(isnotnull(rainfall), round(rainfall, 3)." ".coalesce(units,""), "n/a") | fields value

single.option: not a single ZENTRA chart point — this is accumulated rainfall

search.query: `zentra_interval_precip` device_sn="$device_sn$" | stats sum(value) as rainfall latest(units) as units | eval value = if(isnotnull(rainfall), round(rainfall, 3)." ".coalesce(units,""), "n/a") | fields value

single.title: Rain this week

search.query: `zentra_interval_precip` device_sn="$device_sn$" | stats sum(value) as rainfall latest(units) as units | eval value = if(isnotnull(rainfall), round(rainfall, 3)." ".coalesce(units,""), "n/a") | fields value

single.option: sum of this week's 15-minute Precipitation readings

chart.title: Daily rainfall (sum of that day's 15-minute samples)
Weekly rainfall (sum of that week's 15-minute samples)

table.title: Daily rainfall table — compare a day's total here, not a 15-minute tooltip on ZENTRA

search.query: | bin _time span=1d | stats sum(value) as rainfall latest(units) as units dc(value) as interval_samples by _time, device_sn, measurement | eval rainfall=round(rainfall, 3) | sort - _time | rename _time as day, rainfall as rainfall_total, measurement as zentra_measurement
